messages.subject: Project Falcon - negotiation strategy (internal/privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Agreed on the landing zone. Priorities: (a) availability - 97.75% is fine, do not go to 98%; (b) cap - 135% with a £17.5m supply super-cap is acceptable to Helena, confirmed; (c) payment - 30 days, non-negotiable for cash reasons, but we can offer to drop the advance payment from 15% to 10% as the trade. Let's frame 30-day payment + lower advance as a single concession.

Sarah
